pieces.Text: An enchanting courtesan can subtly deliver an attack by touch. His caress is so pleasurable that the target doesn't automatically realize it was attacked. If the target succeeds at a saving throw against a spell delivered via enchanting touch or a contact poison delivered via the contact poison wielder ability, there is a chance it doesn't notice the attack. The target attempts the saving throw again using all the same modifiers; if it fails this saving throw, it doesn't notice that anything is amiss even though it successfully resisted the effect.
